text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out and about, I came across a crane 
game filled with plushies modeled after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Hey, don't stop so suddenly. Can't 
you even go on a walk proper—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a crane game filled with 
plushies inspired by Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Do you want this doll, little 
puppy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone involved with Umamusume, I'm 
certainly interested... but making Sirius 
Symboli wait while doing it makes me feel 
guilty.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait. If you want it, do it quickly. 
I'll watch you from right here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Just watching a pup gnaw on a toy sounds 
entertaining enough in its own right."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you do well, I might give you a reward. 
You'd best try your hardest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
